risk: P1 bulk consistency and durable acknowledgement

native.scope: Actual production server and Windows Edge with synthetic orders/Collection/quotation/checklist data only. Controlled client replacement and lost HTTP response are labelled separately.

readerNative.scope: Actual Edge Worker → structured model → main ExcelJS → workbook roundtrip, synthetic 10,000-row data only
limits: Browser worker/time/byte/model bounds are not a hard V8/RSS limit.
Two remaining app-main ExcelJS loads consume internally generated workbooks, not uploaded files.

originals.scope: Readonly original seven Desktop files, isolated child parser; no source bytes or cell values copied to report

resolution: History actions are moved by object identity; concurrent newer edits retain their action. CP and Pricing Desk deferred-ACK regressions pass.

CP and Collection prepare on temporary copies. No local persistence/normal-save retry of unknown intents; controlled 500 responses followed by normal notes preserve original values. Collection Undo failure preserves rows and stacks.
Quotation metadata/image projection is delayed until the Collection primary ACK. Controlled 409/500 failures preserve quotation bytes.

contracts.cp: Existing cell commit/history writers captured into one canonical override batch; staged rows and map deltas become live only after ACK. Editing affected CP operations is deferred while saving.
contracts.collection: Existing cell writer prepares the same row PATCH in isolation; kolSaveWorkspaceNow applies acknowledged rows and rebases intervening local deltas. Failed drafts are excluded from pending-workspace recovery.
contracts.pricing: Native price ledger batch has strict price revision and model/row/manufacturer identity guards, fresh record authority and guarded document commit.
contracts.checklist: Existing answer writer receives optional expectedRevision and returns canonical per-item outcomes. Explicit retry receives a fresh preview of rejected keys only.
contracts.receipts: Per-user per-device, last 20 receipts, up to 100000 unique items per intent. Storage failure prevents sending; pending receipts become unknown after restart and never execute.

limits: One final integrated full/CI and batch merge remain; these are targeted and native results, not final project certification.
Browser byte/range/worker/time bounds are not a hard V8/RSS memory limit.
Native error cases deliberately substitute HTTP 409/500 no-write responses; they are not a real SMB/network outage certification.
The seven Desktop workbooks were read only; reports contain file metadata/hashes and counts, no workbook bytes or business cell values.
Receipt retention is bounded and subject to browser local storage quota; a receipt is evidence, never authority or an automatic replay command.
rollback: Revert the BL023 commit; existing single-edit endpoints remain compatible. The new optional receipt storage can be left unused.
